canonical_blocks.name: faq-accordion
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Same Bootstrap FAQ accordion; 'accordion' seen expanded, 'faq-grid' collapsed.

canonical_blocks.name: cards
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Generic repeating card grid (repeating-cards rule). Domain flavors (recipe/event/portal/etc.) likely CSS/content variants; some (pricing, testimonial) split out separately. Confirm cell structure in 3.5.
canonical_blocks.anchor_hint: a grid container with N uniform card children

canonical_blocks.name: feature-grid
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Feature showcase. grid vs list vs single-highlight may be one block with variants or distinct; needs cell-count from 3.5.
canonical_blocks.anchor_hint: feature section (icon + heading + text per item)

canonical_blocks.name: feature-split
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Two-column media+text row (often alternating). Alternation is a variant (variant-is-css-not-new-block); confirm in 3.5.

canonical_blocks.name: testimonial
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Testimonials. Static vs carousel may be a variant or a distinct block.

canonical_blocks.name: cta-banner
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Call-to-action banner variants (differ by copy/target). Mostly CSS/content variants.

canonical_blocks.name: hero
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Hero; image variant is a background/section-style difference.

canonical_blocks.name: comparison-table
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Comparison. table vs cards vs list — structural variants, confirm in 3.5.

canonical_blocks.name: steps
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Numbered/sequential steps. grid vs list ordering may be variant.

canonical_blocks.name: logos
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Logo/badge strip (repeating-cards). May merge with compliance/trust badges.

canonical_blocks.name: trust-badges
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Third-party rating/compliance badges. Possibly same as logos strip; kept separate pending 3.5 (this is the knack-trust-badge-strip candidate).
canonical_blocks.anchor_hint: row of rating/compliance badges with scores

canonical_blocks.name: pricing-table
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Pricing. table vs tier cards — structural variants.
canonical_blocks.anchor_hint: plan columns with price + feature list + CTA

canonical_blocks.name: video-embed
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Embedded video/demo player.

canonical_blocks.name: carousel
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Horizontally scrolling showcase. May split by content (screenshots vs templates).

canonical_blocks.name: steps-triggers-actions
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Knack automation triggers/actions listing. list/table/grid variants; likely a project-specific block.

canonical_blocks.name: templates-gallery
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Template gallery/preview. tabs vs grid variant.

canonical_blocks.name: related-content
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Related/resource teasers. May split (articles vs use-cases) in 3.5.
canonical_blocks.anchor_hint: grid of teaser cards linking elsewhere

canonical_blocks.name: listing
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Directory/listing (often filterable, often under-rendered at capture). Filter bar may be its own block; confirm via Phase 2 DOM.

canonical_blocks.name: stats
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Numeric stat counters.

canonical_blocks.name: form
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Forms/embeds. Native form vs third-party embed differ; confirm in 3.5.

canonical_blocks.name: tabs
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Tabbed content switcher.

canonical_blocks.name: nav
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Navigation chrome (global). Not page content.

canonical_blocks.name: footer
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Global footer chrome.

canonical_blocks.name: image
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Inline content image.

canonical_blocks.name: case-study-callout
canonical_blocks.variant_note: Case-study callout/sidebar. May fold into cards or sidebar block.

canonical_blocks.name: card-stack
canonical_blocks.variant_note: singleton — 1 page, no confident merge; revisit if it recurs.

canonical_rules.trigger: A recurring pre-footer band with tagline/CTA (and the global footer) present on nearly every page.
canonical_rules.decision: Exclude from page block inventory; model once as global footer chrome/fragment.

canonical_rules.trigger: Global top navigation bar / flyout menu present site-wide.
canonical_rules.decision: Exclude from page content; global nav chrome.

canonical_rules.trigger: Thin promo ribbon above the nav (announcement) or a seasonal promo strip inside the hero.
canonical_rules.decision: Exclude as site-wide marketing chrome / fragment, not page content.

canonical_rules.trigger: A visible text node whose content is raw CSS/JS/PHP source or serialized data (comment syntax, selectors, script boilerplate).
canonical_rules.decision: Exclude entirely — source-leak artifact, never content. (Generic candidate; promote cross-site.)

canonical_rules.trigger: A trailing/pre-footer background or gradient band with no captured content (decorative spacer or oversized bg bleed).
canonical_rules.decision: Treat as decorative spacer; fold into section style or ignore. Not a block.

canonical_rules.trigger: FAQ accordion answers appear as detached/duplicated/root-promoted [region] nodes, colliding by coordinates, because they were expanded/animated at capture.
canonical_rules.decision: Reattach answers to their question rows; treat as one faq-accordion block. Dedupe promoted copies.

canonical_rules.trigger: A zone is near-empty in the tree (bg-only / missing text / understated) because content fell below the minWidth capture or loads lazily.
canonical_rules.decision: Do NOT treat as empty. Flag for Phase 2 targeted DOM extraction of that zone.

canonical_rules.trigger: A cross-origin iframe / embedded app-demo / media widget captured as a blank or placeholder zone.
canonical_rules.decision: Mark as an embed block; resolve the embed src via Phase 2, don't treat as empty.

canonical_rules.trigger: The capture landed on a challenge page, redirect, or off-domain URL (Cloudflare, error redirect, scope mismatch).
canonical_rules.decision: Discard the capture; re-capture the intended URL. Not a page structure.

canonical_rules.trigger: Offcanvas/hidden/offscreen duplicates or duplicated carousel/marquee slides promoted into the tree.
canonical_rules.decision: Dedupe against the visible instance; drop the hidden/offscreen copy.

canonical_rules.trigger: A feature/plan/competitor comparison rendered as a table, stacked columns, or comparison cards.
canonical_rules.decision: Model as one comparison block; table vs cards is a variant (resolve cell structure in 3.5). Alternatives: separate blocks per layout.

canonical_rules.trigger: Template previews shown as a carousel, grid, tab strip, or screenshot showcase, often followed by an install/download CTA.
canonical_rules.decision: Model as a template-gallery block (+ separate CTA). Carousel/grid/tabs are variants. Alternatives: distinct blocks per presentation.

canonical_rules.trigger: A [presentation]/list-role container of uniform rows that is an interactive accordion (beyond FAQ).
canonical_rules.decision: Model as an accordion block; the [presentation] role is the accordion, not a plain list.

canonical_rules.trigger: A standalone CTA band (heading + button) that is page content (not the global footer CTA).
canonical_rules.decision: Model as a cta-banner block. A lone button in flow may instead be a default-content link. Alternatives: default-content vs block.

canonical_rules.trigger: A filterable directory/listing with a chip/search filter bar over a grid or list.
canonical_rules.decision: Model as a listing block; the filter bar may be part of it or its own block (confirm via Phase 2). Alternatives: split filter + list.

canonical_rules.trigger: An embedded video, interactive demo, or product-picker widget.
canonical_rules.decision: Model as a media/embed block keyed on the embed source.

canonical_rules.trigger: A sequence of full-width media+text rows with alternating sides.
canonical_rules.decision: One feature block; alternation is a variant label. Alternatives: columns block per row.

canonical_rules.trigger: A customer quote + attribution (single or callout).
canonical_rules.decision: Model as a testimonial block; carousel is a variant.

canonical_rules.trigger: A strip of third-party rating/trust logos with scores near the top of landing pages.
canonical_rules.decision: Model as a trust-badges block (row per badge). May be a variant of a generic logo strip. Alternatives: logos block.

canonical_rules.trigger: A bottom-of-page grid of related article/resource teaser cards.
canonical_rules.decision: Model as a related-content block (cards linking elsewhere).

canonical_rules.trigger: A heading/component sitting on an untagged media/color backdrop spanning a region.
canonical_rules.decision: Represent the backdrop as a section style; map heading + component as separate items (background-container rule).

canonical_rules.trigger: An article/case-study body as a wide primary column + narrow sidebar, or a single-column body needing decomposition.
canonical_rules.decision: Article = default-content, sidebar = its own block, same section. Alternatives: columns block. Decompose via Phase 2.

canonical_rules.trigger: A recurring whole-page skeleton for a section of the site (integration pages, migration landing, category subnav).
canonical_rules.decision: Record as a page-template signature to batch import; not a single block.

canonical_rules.trigger: A page whose body is mostly long-form prose (glossary, pricing package copy) with no repeating component.
canonical_rules.decision: Map the body as default-content (headings/paragraphs/lists), not blocks. Alternatives: extract embedded blocks if present.

canonical_rules.trigger: A numbered how-it-works / steps sequence.
canonical_rules.decision: Model as a steps block, one row per step.

canonical_rules.trigger: A component followed by its caption/label in DOM order.
canonical_rules.decision: Preserve component-then-caption order when authoring the block/default-content.

canonical_rules.trigger: A vertical stack of uniform question rows (each a short heading, often with an expand affordance), typically under an 'FAQ' heading; visual tree marks the container [presentation] with N equal-height children.
canonical_rules.decision: Emit ONE accordion block with one row per Q/A pair. The question is the row's first cell; the answer (may be collapsed/under-rendered) the second — confirm answer text via Phase 2.

canonical_rules.trigger: A pricing page repeats the same '[2x1] plan-name + feature-list' component under 5 separate category headings (Platform usage, Security & compliance, App building, Extensions, plus the top plan-cards block).
canonical_rules.decision: Model each category's comparison as its own instance of a single reusable 'plan-feature-comparison' block (5 instances, one per section), rather than merging all categories into one long master pricing table.

canonical_rules.trigger: A vertical stack of labeled inputs (text, radio, textarea) ending in a submit control, forming an application/contact form.
canonical_rules.decision: Emit ONE 'form' block, one row per field (label + input type/placeholder), final row = submit. Rejected alternative: leave as raw inline HTML form with no block wrapper (loses EDS authoring/reuse for the field list).
